verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API and explicitly describes automating flag toggles from a deploy script via the toggle feature endpoint. A hands-on probe booted the official Docker image and drove user, org, feature and SDK-connection creation entirely through the API with no UI, confirming headless operation. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or CI-specific integration (e.g. a CI action or pipeline guide), a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and config-as-code workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
